🎯 TypedApi Setup

Creating Your First TypedApi Instance 
// Import the generated descriptors
import { dot } from '@polkadot-api/descriptors';

// Create client with WebSocket provider
const client = createClient(
  getWsProvider('wss://rpc.polkadot.io')
);

// Get TypedApi instance - fully typed!
const dotApi = client.getTypedApi(dot);

console.log("TypedApi ready for Polkadot!");
